title: FDA Drug Adverse Events & Side Effects

drugs.title: Drugs
drugs.description: Drug names to look up, one per line ("OZEMPIC", "LIPITOR", "ADDERALL"). Brand or generic names both work. Matched against the reported medicinal product.

mode.title: What to return
mode.description: Top reactions = a ranked list of the most reported side effects for each drug (best starting point). Individual reports = one row per adverse-event report with full detail.

seriousOnly.title: Serious events only
seriousOnly.description: Only events flagged serious (death, hospitalization, disability, life-threatening or other serious outcome).

country.title: Country
country.description: Optional: limit to events that occurred in one country, by two-letter code ("US", "GB", "CA"). Leave empty for worldwide.

sinceYear.title: Reported since year
sinceYear.description: Only events received by the FDA in or after this year. 0 = no limit.

topReactions.title: Top reactions to return
topReactions.description: Top reactions mode: how many of the most reported reactions to return per drug.

maxPerDrug.title: Reports per drug
maxPerDrug.description: Individual reports mode: how many reports to return per drug (newest first).

apiKey.title: openFDA API key (optional)
apiKey.description: Optional: your own free openFDA API key. Raises the shared daily limit (1,000 requests/day per IP) to 120,000/day. Get one free at open.fda.gov/apis/authentication.

maxRows.title: Max rows
maxRows.description: Stop after this many rows in total.
